proof.criterion: A3 and review finding 1: an interrupt keeps queued cards folded with no turn. This covers an interrupt during prompt setup and an abort in a retry's backoff; after an Esc, the next idle card's turn reads every card.
proof.command: The implementer's 5 interrupt cases, plus my round-1 cases T1 to T4 at this head ($TMPDIR/tester-cases.test.ts; source in https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2278#issuecomment-6429361602)
proof.observed: All 5 implementer cases pass and all 4 of mine pass. In T3 (abort during the 529 retry backoff) no turn follows the abort, and the probe's request carries the card with no wake text. In T4 the idle card after abort_and_restore_queue starts one turn that reads all 4 cards.

notes: For the reviewer: src/card-wake.ts, around lines 50-52, says a setup card is taken by the prompt's loop 'at the first step'. On the real binary (S1, S1b) it is in the run's 2nd model request. No card is lost, but the comment is wrong.
